title: 252. String to Integer (atoi)

examples.explanation: The string starts directly with digits, giving 42.
Spaces are skipped, the minus sign is applied, and 042 parses to 42.
Reading stops at the first non-digit, so the result is 1337.

hints: Walk the string with an index: first spaces, then an optional sign, then digits. Anything else ends the parse.
Accumulate into a wider (64-bit) variable or check the bounds before each multiply-and-add so overflow clamps correctly.
